app.title: OmaKhinsider
app.subtitle: Soundtrack downloads and playlists
app.scope_note: Completed albums leave the queue and appear in Library > Downloaded. Failed or canceled albums stay queued; retries reuse verified completed files.
player.select: Choose an album in Library, then Play album.
bar_player.heading: Top-bar player
bar_player.help: Show compact controls beside the clock during playback, including when paused. The KH library icon stays where it is. Click the title or volume icon for seeking and volume; Show album opens the library. These settings change only the bar layout.
bar_player.volume_seek: Volume and seeking (scroll to adjust volume)
bar_player.playback_error: Playback failed. Retry Play or open the album for details.
messages.bar_player_failed: Could not apply top-bar player settings. Check the error and retry.
player.not_downloaded: Download every track in this playlist before playing it.
player.online_failed: Online playback failed: %1. The link may have expired. Use Show album > More... > Refresh inspection, inspect with the browser companion, then retry Play.
player.online_invalid: This online playlist has invalid audio links. Refresh its inspection before playing.
browser.open_tooltip: Open KHInsider in the default browser
setup.title: Browser setup
setup.required: Album inspection requires the browser companion.
setup.intro: Installing the plugin alone does not connect your browser. Set up the extension and its native messaging host once. Downloaded albums can still be imported and played without them.
setup.prerequisites: Use installed Chromium or Firefox, Python 3, Bash, and a running Omarchy shell with this plugin enabled. The installer supports native Chromium and Firefox, not Chrome, Brave, or sandboxed browser packages. Copy the commands below into a terminal; no sudo is needed.
setup.firefox_temporary: Firefox developer setup only: the unsigned temporary extension disappears when Firefox restarts. Reload it each session. Persistent normal Firefox installation requires a Mozilla-signed extension, which this project does not yet distribute.
setup.build_help: Choose your browser above, then copy and run this command block. This only copies bundled files; no Node.js, npm, or download is required.
setup.load_chromium: Open chrome://extensions in Chromium, enable Developer mode, choose Load unpacked, and select the folder below. Pin OmaKhinsider to the browser toolbar. This is a folder path, not a terminal command.
setup.load_firefox: Open about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox, choose Load Temporary Add-on, and select manifest.json inside the folder below. Open OmaKhinsider through Firefox's Extensions menu. This is a folder path, not a terminal command.
setup.register_chromium: Copy OmaKhinsider's ID from chrome://extensions and paste it below. Then copy and run the generated command block. Use the ID from this exact installed extension, not its name.
setup.register_firefox: Run this command block. Firefox uses the extension's fixed ID; there is no ID to paste.
setup.extension_id_invalid: Use the complete 32-letter ID from chrome://extensions (letters a-p only).
setup.verify_help: Open the companion in your browser toolbar and select Test plugin connection. It must say Connected to OmaKhinsider. This tests browser > native host > running plugin, without changing your queue or library. No album page is needed. It does not test access to the site or audio servers.
setup.inspect_help: Open a KHInsider album page (not a track page). In the companion, choose Inspect album for downloads and keep the tab open. When finished, return to Album queue: the album appears automatically. Choose Download or Save for streaming. Send to Album Queue only fills the URL field; press Add album in the plugin to queue it without inspection.
setup.troubleshoot_host: Cannot connect to native host: rerun registration for the selected browser and current extension ID. Confirm Python 3 is installed. Close and reopen the extension popup. Chrome/Brave and sandboxed browsers need different host locations and are not configured by this installer.
setup.troubleshoot_plugin: Plugin unavailable or still loading: enable OmaKhinsider in Omarchy, reopen the panel, and resolve any library-load error. If testing gives an invalid request, rebuild/reload the extension and rerun registration so both ends use the updated protocol.
setup.troubleshoot_site: Inspection unavailable: open the album's main page, complete any normal site checks in that browser, then reopen the companion. Keep the tab on the same album while inspecting. A successful connection test does not bypass site checks or guarantee media access.
setup.update_help: Rebuild using step 1, reload the extension in the browser's extension manager, and rerun step 3. If its directory or Chromium ID changes, use the new ID. Firefox temporary installations must be loaded again after every browser restart.
setup.remove_help: Remove OmaKhinsider in your browser's extension manager. The project's bundled README lists the exact native-host registration and helper paths to remove. Removing the companion does not delete downloaded music or the plugin's saved library.
album.heading: Add an album
album.help: Inspect opens the album in your browser. Use the companion's Inspect album for downloads button, then return here to download.
album.add_online_tooltip: Save this inspected album for streaming without downloading it. The album stays in the queue.
album.format_unavailable: No compatible format for the whole album. Check Tracks or change the preferred format.
album.empty:
No albums queued.
Browse KHInsider or paste an album URL above.
settings.heading: Download settings
settings.directory_help: New downloads get an album subfolder here. Save applies this location and scans for existing albums; it does not move your audio. Enter an absolute path or ~/folder.
settings.format_help: Use the preferred format when every track offers it. Otherwise download the album as MP3 when all tracks offer MP3.
support.heading: Feedback and support
support.open: Request a feature / Report a bug
support.help: Opens this plugin's GitHub issue forms in your browser. Check existing issues before submitting. No library data or diagnostics are sent automatically.
messages.support_opened: GitHub issue forms opened. Choose a feature request or bug report.
messages.support_open_failed: Could not open GitHub in your default browser. Visit https://github.com/kelmankenberg/OmaKhinsider/issues to submit feedback.
download.all_tooltip: Download inspected, compatible albums in queue order. Uninspected or incompatible albums stay queued.
playlist.heading: Playlist library
library.no_matches: No matches. Try a different search.
library.relink_help: Choose the replacement folder for this album. Keeps this playlist's name and merges any already-imported copy. Audio files are never moved or deleted.
library.folder_missing: Folder missing. Locate its new location to play this album again.
library.refresh_help: Scan the download folder for copied or moved albums. Complete manifests import automatically; older or external folders require review.
library.preview_help: Check the inferred titles and order. Older folders may be incomplete. Import saves album metadata here without changing audio files; Import all checks every pending album and reports failures.
playlist.custom_empty:
No custom playlists yet.
Downloaded albums are listed under Downloaded.
playlist.refresh_help: Open the saved album URL, then use Inspect album for downloads in the browser companion. Its refreshed links update this online playlist.
playlist.delete_confirm: Remove this entry and its saved track list from the library? Audio files stay on disk. Refresh folders can rediscover downloaded albums.
playlist.empty:
No downloaded albums.
Download an album or use Refresh folders to find existing ones.
playlist.no_tracks: No tracks in this playlist yet. Downloaded albums are added as separate playlists.
playlist.select_help: Select an album to view its tracks and play it. More contains rename, details, and library maintenance.
messages.album_staged_from_browser: Album URL filled in. Select Add album to queue it.
messages.browser_inspection_help: On the album page, open the OmaKhinsider companion and select Inspect album for downloads. Keep that tab open until inspection finishes.
messages.album_inspected: Album inspected. View Tracks, download it, or add an online playlist.
messages.online_playlist_saved: Saved in Library > Online. Choose Play album to stream it; the album remains queued.
messages.online_add_help: Inspect an album in the queue, then choose Add online playlist.
messages.online_needs_inspection: Inspect this album before adding its online playlist.
messages.online_format_unavailable: Every track must offer MP3 or every track must offer FLAC to stream this album.
messages.inspection_failed: Album inspection failed. Check the error and retry from the browser companion.
messages.inspection_invalid: The browser supplied invalid album information.
messages.album_not_found: That album is no longer in the queue.
messages.folder_selected: Folder selected. Choose Save settings to apply it and scan for albums.
messages.folder_chooser_failed: Could not choose a folder. Check that Zenity is installed, or enter the path directly.
messages.library_scanned: Scan finished. Verified albums are in Downloaded. Use Review for newly discovered albums or folders needing attention.
messages.library_imported: Album imported with a portable folder manifest.
messages.library_relinking: Checking and relinking the replacement album folder...
messages.library_relinked: Album folder relinked. The original playlist name was kept and any already-imported copy was merged.
messages.library_relink_invalid: The replacement must be the same album and audio format as the original playlist. No library changes were saved.
messages.batch_none_ready: No albums are ready. Inspect an album and check its available audio formats first.
messages.library_importing_all: Importing all pending albums. Individual failures will not stop the remaining imports.
messages.library_import_all_complete: Import all finished. Imported albums are in Downloaded.
messages.library_import_all_errors: Import all finished with errors. Successful albums are in Downloaded; failed folders remain for review. See Folders needing attention for details.
messages.library_failed: Folder scan or import failed. Check the error and refresh folders to retry.
messages.library_import_invalid: The scanned album information is invalid. No playlist changes were saved.
messages.settings_invalid: Enter a valid download folder and audio format.
messages.download_complete: Album downloaded and moved from the queue to Library > Downloaded.
messages.download_result_invalid: Downloaded files could not be recorded as a playlist. The album remains queued and its files are kept; retry to verify them.
messages.batch_empty: There are no albums to download.
messages.batch_format_unavailable: This album does not offer the preferred format or MP3 for every track. Check Tracks or change the preferred format in Settings.
messages.batch_finished: Ready albums finished downloading. Completed albums are in Library > Downloaded.
messages.batch_finished_with_errors: Batch finished with errors. Completed albums are in Library > Downloaded; failed albums remain queued.
messages.batch_canceled: Batch canceled. Finished albums are in Library > Downloaded; incomplete albums remain queued.
messages.download_canceled: Download canceled. Completed tracks are kept for a retry.
messages.download_failed: Download failed. Completed tracks are kept. Check the error, or inspect again if links expired.
messages.browser_opened: Opened KHInsider in the default browser.
messages.browser_open_failed: Could not open KHInsider in the default browser.
messages.album_url_invalid: Enter a valid HTTPS KHInsider album URL.
messages.album_duplicate: That album is already in the queue.
messages.playlist_name_too_long: Playlist names can be up to 100 characters.
messages.playlist_name_invalid: That playlist name contains characters that cannot be used in folder names.
messages.playlist_name_duplicate: A playlist with that name already exists.
messages.track_duplicate: That track is already in the playlist.
messages.state_save_failed: Could not save changes. The previous saved state was restored.
errors.state_invalid: The library file is invalid. It was not overwritten; fix or move it before reopening the plugin.
errors.state_read_failed: Could not read the library file. Check its permissions and try again.
errors.worker_response_invalid: The download helper returned an invalid response.
errors.worker_failed: The download helper could not complete the operation. Check that Python 3 and the plugin's backend files are installed.
